title: When the Sahara Was Green: The Lost Lakes and Wildlife of Earth's Largest Desert
description:
Discover how the Sahara transformed from a lush, green landscape filled with lakes, hippos, and crocodiles into the largest hot desert on Earth. Explore the ancient rock art and climate shifts that reveal a completely different prehistoric world.

Understanding how the Sahara underwent such a dramatic climate change offers vital clues about Earth's environmental history and future climate cycles. It shows how rapidly our planet's ecosystems can transform.
